sections.heading: Tom Holland — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Tom Holland was born on 1 June 1996 in Kingston upon Thames, and holds British nationality. He was given the name Thomas Stanley Holland at birth and is publicly known as Tom Holland.
Public records name his father, Dominic Holland. He is a sibling of Harry Holland and Paddy Holland.
He studied at BRIT School for Performing Arts and Technology, Wimbledon College, Richard Challoner School and Donhead Preparatory School.
He is recorded as speaking English.
